items.summary: Personal todo management skill. Parses natural-language todos from the session (task text, importance, urgency, note, workspace dir, related docs, links, due time), appends them to date-partitioned storage files, and auto-maintains an index (todo / in_progress / urgent / done / archived). Language policy: the AI conversation follows the user's language; CLI/API output is fixed English; the web UI is i18n (English default, switchable to Chinese; inline, offline-safe). A triage entry (`triage`) decides add / update / status / delete from one sentence with pure rules (no LLM), returns JSON, and asks for confirmation when unsure; an optional capture service (global hotkey reads the clipboard — no filtering, the clipboard text is used as the task text — feeds the triage entry and shows system dialogs for anything that needs confirmation or input) runs inside the web UI process and is managed from a Settings page (hotkey + triage-type toggles).
